items.speak_text: I'm writing a blog post about running large language models locally, and I need you to help me outline it. items.speak_text: Here's the bug report. Since Monday at around nine A M, roughly two percent of requests to the checkout endpoint return a five oh two error. It only happens behind Cloudflare, never when we hit the origin directly, and it seems worse during the European morning. The Nginx logs show the upstream closing the connection after exactly sixty seconds. I suspect the keepalive timeout on the load balancer is shorter than the one in Node, so please compare the two settings, propose a fix, and tell me how we can verify it without touching production traffic.
items.reference: Here's the bug report. Since Monday at around 9 a.m., roughly 2% of requests to the checkout endpoint return a 502 error.
